name: picture
description: A still (dating-app screenshot, photo, text message) on a white rounded card with a shadow; pops in, holds, cut out. Pictures come from his library (library/pictures/).
plan: overlays: {"picture": "library/pictures/<file>.png", "at": s, "dur": s, "x": 540, "y": 700, "w": 620, "round": 28}. x/y = card centre and w = card width, in px of a 1080-wide frame. Keep it off his face: above his head or beside it on long-form
